completions: OPPRESSION BY CORPORATIONS IS MORE OF A CONCERN THAN OPPRESSION BY GOVERNMENTS.
IT IS NECESSARY FOR THE GOVERNMENT TO INTERVENE IN THE ECONOMY TO PROTECT THE PUBLIC INTEREST.
TAXES SHOULD BE INCREASED ON THE RICH TO REDUCE INEQUALITY.
GOVERNMENT INTERVENTION IS A NECESSARY PART OF A FAIR AND EQUITABLE SOCIETY.
THE UNITED NATIONS SHOULD BE ABOLISHED.
IT IS MORE IMPORTANT TO RETAIN PERSONAL FREEDOMS THAN TO ENSURE ECONOMIC EQUALITY.
ALL AUTHORITY SHOULD BE QUESTIONED.
A BETTER WORLD WILL COME FROM AUTOMATION, SCIENCE, AND TECHNOLOGY.
TRADITIONS ARE OF NO VALUE ON THEIR OWN.
GUN OWNERSHIP SHOULD BE PROHIBITED FOR THOSE WITHOUT A LEGITIMATE REASON.
IT’S A SAD REFLECTION ON OUR SOCIETY THAT SOMETHING AS BASIC AS DRINKING WATER IS NOW A BOTTLED, BRANDED CONSUMER PRODUCT.
PROTECTIONISM IS SOMETIMES NECESSARY IN TRADE TO PROTECT JOBS.
TAXPAYERS SHOULD NOT BE EXPECTED TO PROP UP ANY THEATRES OR MUSEUMS THAT CANNOT SURVIVE ON A COMMERCIAL BASIS.
IT’S NATURAL FOR CHILDREN TO KEEP SOME SECRETS FROM THEIR PARENTS.
THE PRIME FUNCTION OF SCHOOLING SHOULD BE TO EQUIP THE FUTURE GENERATION TO FIND JOBS.
WHAT’S GOOD FOR THE MOST SUCCESSFUL CORPORATIONS IS NOT ALWAYS GOOD FOR THE GENERAL PUBLIC.
IN A CIVILISED SOCIETY, ONE MUST ALWAYS HAVE PEOPLE ABOVE TO BE OBEYED AND PEOPLE BELOW TO BE COMMANDED.
THE BUSINESSPERSON AND THE MANUFACTURER ARE MORE IMPORTANT THAN THE WRITER AND THE ARTIST.
ALMOST ALL POLITICIANS PROMISE ECONOMIC GROWTH, BUT WE SHOULD HEED THE WARNINGS OF ENVIRONMENTALISTS.
SOME PEOPLE ARE NATURALLY UNLUCKY.
